dedupe_keys.name: stowa digitale diensten software tools calculation instruments and digital overviews for dutch water boards

description: STOWA, the applied research foundation of the Dutch regional water authorities, lists on its digital services page the software tools, calculation instruments and digital overviews it has developed, often with partners. The page read on 2026-09-28 groups them under climate adaptation, water safety, water quality and wastewater treatment, energy transition, circular economy and other topics; examples include a decision framework for letting in water of other origin during drought, a framework for fresh-salt dynamics, the Fresh Water Options Optimizer for mapping local freshwater storage options, Meteobase with precipitation and evaporation data (transferred to the WIWB service on 1 January 2018), and the Netherlands Hydrological Instrument, the software and data for national and regional groundwater and surface water models including the National Hydrological Model used in the Delta Model. Coverage is the Netherlands. Access is free through the linked tools; licences are set per tool and were not read. Caveats: the page is a directory, so each tool must be judged on its own, and some have moved to other hosts. It supports drought, flood and wastewater planning by giving a route to Dutch water management models and data. No related STOWA record is catalogued.
